How repeat orders will work

A repeat order sends the same products and strengths on a schedule you choose, so a study that runs for months does not stall while a reorder is placed. Subscribe and save is not open yet. When it opens, the plan is for each product page to offer a repeat option, managed from your account once online accounts are available.

The discount, the delivery intervals and the rules for changing an order will be listed on this page before the program starts. No saving or schedule is promised until then.

What a standing order suits

  • Long studies with a fixed design, where the same compound and strength are used from start to finish.
  • Supplies used at a steady rate, such as bacteriostatic water, syringes, needles and alcohol swabs.
  • Labs that budget ahead and want the same order arriving on a known schedule.

A one-off pilot or a study whose design may change is usually better served by single orders, so you are not committed to vials you may not need.

Planning a repeat order

  1. Work out the rate. Count the vials and supplies each stage of your study uses, and set the interval from that, with a margin for transit time.
  2. Check storage space. Each product page lists its storage conditions, and every delivery needs room in the right storage as soon as it arrives. The storage guide covers how vials are kept before and after mixing.
  3. Expect lot changes. Keep a record of the lot each delivery came from, and match it to its certificate on the lab results page when one is published.
  4. Watch the origin. Stock is shown for each ship-from origin on the product page, and the shipping page explains how origins work.

Until the program opens

If your lab needs a standing order now, write to us at support@d2cpeptides.com with the products, strengths, quantities and interval you have in mind, and we will tell you what we can arrange. Regular high volumes may suit a wholesale account better, with terms confirmed on application.

To see every strength with its price and stock status, browse the peptide shop. Repeat orders are sold on the same terms as single orders: for laboratory research only, under the research use policy.

Frequently asked questions

How much do I save with a subscription?

The discount has not been set, so this page promises no saving yet. When subscribe and save opens, the discount and the products it covers will be listed here before anyone signs up. Until then, every item is sold at the price shown on its product page, and larger regular volumes can be quoted through a wholesale account instead.

Can I pause, skip or cancel a repeat order?

The rules for changing, pausing, skipping and cancelling a repeat order will be published here when the program opens, together with any notice period. Until then, nothing repeats automatically: each order is placed and confirmed on its own, so there is nothing to cancel. If you set up a standing arrangement with us by email, changes go through the same address.

Will every delivery come from the same lot?

We cannot promise that, so plan for the lot to change between deliveries. Keep a record of the lot each delivery came from. Certificates of analysis are listed by product and lot on the lab results page when they are published. If your study needs a single lot from start to finish, say so when you write to us about a standing order, and ask what we can arrange.

Can supplies be part of a repeat order?

Yes, that is the plan. The program is meant to cover both research peptides and the lab supplies used with them, such as bacteriostatic water, syringes, needles and alcohol swabs. Exactly which items are included will be confirmed when the program opens and listed on this page.
